name: Unidentified OOM command battle droid 2 (Ryloth blockade)
wookieepedia_title: Unidentified OOM command battle droid 2 (Ryloth blockade)
description: An OOM command battle droid was one of the commanding officers in the Ryloth blockade during the Battle of Ryloth, in which the Confederacy of Independent Systems invaded and blockaded the planet Ryloth.
